approved_scope.title: A warm status of an archived change does not digest the whole working tree to report its review currency
approved_scope.description: A warm status of an archived change does not digest the whole working tree to report its review currency
acceptance_criteria: An archived change takes the project-input digest for scoped_review_current only while its archived package has uncommitted changes; a committed archive reports false without the digest
On Raven (150 archives) a warm archived change status drops from 183 Git processes to about 53; before and after times are recorded
States before archive compute scoped_review_current exactly as today; the next action, every gate and every refusal are unchanged

an_archived_change_reports_the_scoped_review_currency_the_full_check_gives passes unchanged: an archived change reports the scoped_review_current the full check gives today, true right after finalize while the archive is uncommitted and false once committed, after later commits, after an unrelated edit and for a moved archive

warm_archived_status_git_processes_do_not_grow_with_tracked_files passes: 3000 more tracked files add fewer than 3 Git processes to a warm archived change status (committed failing first in a5b54557: 89 -> 196)

answers.constraints: SPEED-1.a (status of an archived change under 2 s on Raven, warm included), SPEED-1.d (benchmark); the summary already computes verification_current and scoped_edits_uncommitted only in the states that use them; change.3md 'Finalize judges only what it archives' (read paths keep live-identical answers); REQ-change-119 archived-read guards stay
